title: Tabs
description: Tabs over a picture and a text each: one tab is open, a click or the arrow keys open another. Without JavaScript every tab stands under its title.

schema.label: Tabs
schema.help: The first is open when the page opens.

children.label: Title of the tab
children.help: A tab without a title, or with nothing under it, is not shown.

schema.label: Picture
schema.help: Beside the text where the column has room for both, above it where it has not.

schema.label: Tabs in rows on a narrow screen
schema.help: Where the tabs do not fit in one row they stand in two or more, sharing each row, instead of scrolling sideways.

schema.label: Picture to the edges of the screen on a narrow screen
schema.help: Where the column is narrow the picture of a tab runs from one side of the screen to the other, without the margins and the rounded corners; the heading, the tabs and the text keep to the column. Wider, nothing changes.

schema.label: Change of tab
schema.help: Fade keeps the block as tall as its tallest tab, so it does not jump between pictures of different proportions. Where the visitor asked for less motion it changes at once.

schema.label: Slide over the section above
schema.help: The section above stays in place while this one comes up over it, and its words fade. The edge pictures stand over this section's top. Visitors who ask for less motion see the sections one after another.

schema.label: Edge picture
schema.help: Over the top of this section, as wide as the page: fog or clouds in a PNG or WebP with transparency, its bottom row in the colour of this section.

schema.label: Edge picture on a phone
schema.help: The same edge for a narrow screen. Without it the edge picture above is used there too.
